summary.zh-CN: 自注意力让序列中的每个位置都能查看同一序列的其他位置：当前位置用 [[term:qkv-projection|Query]] 发出检索需求，与所有位置的 Key 计算匹配程度，再用这些权重对 Value 做加权汇总，得到带有上下文的新表示。
summary.en-US: Self-attention lets every position in a sequence inspect other positions in the same sequence. The current position uses a [[term:qkv-projection|Query]] to express a retrieval need, matches it against every position's Key, and uses the resulting weights to aggregate Values into a new context-aware representation.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 自注意力把“当前位置需要什么”与“其他位置提供什么”进行匹配，再按匹配结果汇总信息。
coreConclusion.en-US: Self-attention matches what the current position needs with what other positions provide, then aggregates information according to the match.
